race.comment: PINOT PIRATE (11) looks the one to beat after winning easily on debut at Gatton before being run down late by a handy one in town. Third-up now, he sets up a treat with 3kg claim and should prove awfully hard to run down. MILLENNIUM BLADE (4) has gone better than his form reads in his two runs back and is dropping back from Saturday grade. His form references stack right up and gets help at the weights with the 2kg claimer going on. Expect to see him charging hard late. DUKE OF ALBEMARLE (9) possesses a strong turn of foot on his day but has been leaving himself with too much ground to bridge. Blinkers go on first time to hopefully sharpen him up and if he can hold a spot from the draw, he can cause a big scare. ARMES (1) resumes from a long break, but he showed encouraging signs in his debut prep and has trialled well in readiness. Maloney booking from the low draw also adds to the case.
